name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
outlook:
What Hewlett Packard Enterprise says to expect

  • Fiscal 2026: revenue growthHPE is raising its FY26 revenue growth outlook range to 34% to 37%. HPE is raising revenue growth expectations for the Networking segment to 73% to 74%.
  • Fiscal 2026: free cash flowHPE is also raising its free cash flow (1)(2)(4) guidance and now expects free cash flow to be at least $3.75 billion.
  • Fiscal 2027: growth frameworkHPE is raising its revenue growth outlook range to 13% to 17%. HPE is raising expectations for non-GAAP diluted net EPS growth to be in the range of 16% to 20% (1)(4) . HPE estimates non-GAAP operating margin rate to be in the range of 14% to 15% (1)(4) .
  • Fiscal 2027: free cash flowHPE is also raising its free cash flow guidance and now expects free cash flow to be at least $5.0 billion (1)(2)(4) .
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 2, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
